description: This file contains a function `computeAIMove` that determines the next move for an AI player in a Tic-Tac-Toe game, based on heuristic strategies including winning, blocking, taking the center, corners, or sides.

methods.name: computeAIMove(squares, aiPlayer = 'O', humanPlayer = 'X')
methods.description: Calculates the optimal move index for the AI in a given Tic-Tac-Toe board state based on prioritized strategies.
